name: pitmaster
description: Skills for running work with your agent: grill the plan before it starts (bbq), record decisions as ADRs (makeadr), find what is holding a voyage back (swarm-bottleneck), pick its budget (budget-select) and models (tier-select), record what it spent beside what it landed (spend-ledger), let the agent pick the work (dealers-choice) and give it standing authority for a session (carte-blanche), set a project up for agents (project-prep), talk a subject through, then write one record of what was said (talk-through), audit blind whether a repo or an app is ready for its end users (tastetest), carry a settled plan on into the build, stopping at "ratify" (goforit), find what was left unfinished and offer to tie it off (looseends), and run release day, approving each public copy on the way out (setfree).
